title: SAAM Machine Manifest
description: Describes one machine: model-level planning constraints, installed capabilities, its post-processor, and where instance-specific configuration lives. This schema validates each machine's manifest.json.

id.description: Permanent identity, referenced by process plans' `machine.id`.

modelConstraints.description: Facts true of the machine model in general, independent of any one physical unit. Safe to publish; cite a source rather than asserting an unverified number.

motionPrimitives.description: Native motion commands the controller exposes (e.g. joint move, linear move, arc).

reachMm.description: null when not yet confirmed against manufacturer documentation.

sourceNote.description: Where these facts come from (manufacturer datasheet, DOC-CONFIRMED docs, etc.) and their confidence.

capabilities.description: Which operation `capabilityRequirements` this machine (as configured) satisfies, each with its own evidence — a capability being listed does not mean every requesting operation has been tested on it.

installedTooling.description: Optional, installation-specific equipment mounted on this machine class (e.g. a fixed-nozzle extrusion end effector). Describes what a reference installation looks like; not a claim that every unit has it.

safetyNotes.description: Generalized safety lessons. Never a substitute for hands-on caution; never instance-specific enough to double as calibration data.

fields.description: Names of values that vary per physical unit (calibration coefficients, bed height, frame IDs, I/O channel assignments) and must never be committed as real facility data to a public fork.

example.description: Path to a synthetic example instance profile, for format reference only.

postProcessor.description: id of the post-processor that emits this machine's native output.
